name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring installation project depends on several factors, including the type of flooring, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparation. A small room with laminate or LVP might take 1-2 days, while a larger area or complex tile work could extend to 3-5 days or more. Projects requiring old flooring removal, subfloor repairs, or custom designs will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed timeline after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by flooring type, area size, and subfloor needs, typically 1-5 days. We provide a detailed timeline after assessment.
